title: Calm-Belly Plant Kitchen
subtitle: Four vegan, low-FODMAP, gluten-free recipes and a week to cook them in
intro: Bright, gentle food: no onion or garlic, but plenty of flavour from garlic-infused oil, the green tops of spring onions, ginger, citrus and toasted seeds.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Tofu & Quinoa Bowl
recipes.description: Crisp maple-tamari tofu over fluffy quinoa with charred zucchini, carrot ribbons and a zingy lemon-herb drizzle.
steps: Simmer the quinoa in **1 1/2 cups** salted water, covered, for 15 minutes. Turn off the heat and leave the lid on for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Cut the pressed tofu into 2 cm cubes and toss with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt.
Heat 1 tbsp of the garlic-infused oil in a large non-stick pan. Fry the tofu for 8–10 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides.
Whisk the tamari and maple syrup, pour over the tofu and toss for 1 minute until sticky and glazed. Set aside.
In the same pan, char the zucchini for 3–4 minutes over high heat. Wilt the spinach in for the last 30 seconds.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon zest, juice, parsley, spring onion greens, salt and pepper.
Divide the quinoa between bowls, top with tofu, vegetables, carrot ribbons and tomatoes, then spoon over the drizzle and scatter with pumpkin seeds.

swaps.why: Fructans in garlic don't dissolve in oil, so you keep the flavour without the FODMAPs.
The green tops are low-FODMAP; the white bulbs are not.
Regular soy sauce is brewed with wheat.

tips: Pressing the tofu is what makes it crisp — wrap it in a clean towel under a heavy pan.
Leftovers keep 3 days; store the drizzle separately.

recipes.title: Golden Pumpkin & Red Lentil Curry
recipes.description: A cosy coconut curry with sweet kabocha, ginger and warm spices, finished with lime and fresh coriander.
steps: Start the rice: rinse until the water runs clear, then cook with **2 1/4 cups** water, covered, on low for 15 minutes.
Warm the garlic-infused oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the asafoetida and ginger and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the cumin, turmeric, garam masala and chili flakes and toast for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, tomatoes, coconut milk and water. Simmer, partly covered, for 15–18 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Stir in the lentils and spinach and cook 3 minutes more. Season with salt.
Serve over rice with lime wedges and plenty of fresh cilantro.

swaps.why: Asafoetida adds the savoury, oniony depth. Choose one cut with rice flour, not wheat.
Kabocha is low-FODMAP in generous serves; butternut is only low in small amounts.

tips: Tastes even better the next day. Freezes well for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Peanut-Lime Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Silky rice noodles tossed with crunchy vegetables and a creamy peanut, lime and chili sauce. Ready in 25 minutes.
steps: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the packet, then rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk all the sauce ingredients until smooth and pourable.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Fry the tofu for 5 minutes until golden, then push to one side.
Add the carrot, pepper and bok choy and stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender-crisp.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 1–2 minutes until everything is glossy and hot.
Top with peanuts, spring onion greens and chili.

swaps.why: Vegan, and low-FODMAP where honey is not.

recipes.title: Berry Chia Overnight Oats
recipes.description: A make-ahead breakfast jar: creamy oats and chia with maple, cinnamon and a pile of fresh berries.
steps: Stir the oats, chia, almond milk, maple syrup, cinnamon and vanilla together in a bowl or two jars.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 4 hours.
In the morning, loosen with a splash more almond milk and top with berries and pumpkin seeds.
tips: Make four jars on Sunday — they keep for 4 days in the fridge.

meal_plan.title: A calm-belly week
meal_plan.intro: Cook twice, eat all week. Curry and quinoa are batch-cooked on Sunday and Wednesday.
prep_ahead: Sunday: cook the curry and a pot of rice; make four jars of overnight oats.
Wednesday: cook a second batch of quinoa and press the tofu for Thursday.
